assessment: B-level decision page for "aeo vs seo" (1900/mo, KD 17): the verdict card answers the choice above the fold, every H2 opens with a direct answer, and the recommendation is backed by AEOeye's own measurements (AEOeye AI Crawler Access Study (391 sites, 2026-10-03); AEOeye AI recommendation benchmark (892 answers)) with limitations stated.

topic.readerProblem: A site owner deciding "aeo vs seo" needs a straight recommendation and the evidence for it.
topic.connection: Defines the line between SEO and the AI-visibility measurement AEOeye sells, using AEOeye audit and crawler data.

sources.supports: No additional requirements for AI Overviews/AI Mode; page must be indexed and snippet-eligible; preview controls apply.
Pew: 8% click a result with an AI summary vs 15% without; 1% click a link inside the summary.
GEO paper: generative engine optimization can boost visibility by up to 40% in generative engine responses.
GPTBot = training, OAI-SearchBot = ChatGPT search, ChatGPT-User = user actions; ~24h for robots.txt changes.
ClaudeBot (training), Claude-SearchBot (search), Claude-User (user requests); bots honor robots.txt and Crawl-delay.
AEOeye benchmark: 892 answers, 17.6% mention rate, ChatGPT 5% of 161, ~2.9 competitors per answer.
AEOeye 391-site robots.txt study: per-bot block rates by group (e.g. GPTBot 9.1%, ClaudeBot 11.5%, Bytespider 14.6%).

checks: Re-read every factual claim against the cited primary sources, fetched on 2026-10-24 (7 sources listed on the page); unverifiable statements were removed or reworded before publishing.

Title/H1, secondary-keyword H2s and meta description match the locked three-round plan in docs/seo-v2/final-table.json.

artifacts.description: AEOeye AI Crawler Access Study (391 sites, 2026-10-03) — the raw data behind the figures quoted in this decision page.
AEOeye AI recommendation benchmark (892 answers) — the raw data behind the figures quoted in this decision page.

methodology: Figures come from AEOeye's own zero-cost measurements published under /resources: plain HTTP requests from a self-identified research user agent (AEOeyeResearch), robots.txt respected, 1 s between requests per domain; encoding tests run locally with cwebp/avifenc and SSIM via ffmpeg. Each dataset file states its exact method.
limitations: Convenience sample of well-known sites (not the whole web), homepages only, a single snapshot on 2026-10-24; the image test covers 20 screenshots, not photographs.
